scenes.scene: a young woman with shoulder-length black hair tied in a low ponytail, wearing a teal short-sleeve shirt and dark grey jeans stands behind a narrow counter in a tiny shop, pressing a small plain colored sticker onto the paper sleeve of a milk tea cup, a sheet of blank stickers lying on the counter.
